title: Question 16
passage:
Is it okay to hang my jacket on a hook during the recital?
A. The recital program lists six groups. B. Sure, any empty hook is fine. C. I bought mine at the mall last week.
passageZh:
成果發表會進行時，我可以把外套掛在掛鉤上嗎？
A. 節目單列了六組表演。
B. 可以，空著的掛鉤都能用。
C. 我上週在購物中心買了自己的外套。
